BattleStall_Text_Npc0.fr: Les objets durent un combat.\nUtilise-les sur le boss.
BattleStall_Text_Npc0.en: Items last one battle. Use them on\nthe boss, not on rats.

BattleStall_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

BattleStall_Text_ShopHi.fr: Gagne avant que le combat ne\ncommence.

BattleStall_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
BattleStall_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
